name: Portable Canonical Work Exact Dispatch
purpose: Invoke the existing already-local sovereign source refresh plus exact canonical_work_coordination resident dispatch bridge for one manifest-bound Goal Task, preserving Task Registry anti-collision preflight, WorkerCoordinator claim/fence authority, Interlock/InTr transition authority, and runtime evidence boundaries without creating another runtime, scheduler, dispatcher, request identity, or authority plane.
trigger: an existing canonical Goal Task requires an on-demand portable canonical_work_coordination invocation through the already-implemented refresh_and_dispatch_resident_requests.py bridge
scope: one invocation-bound local source root, one invocation-bound sovereign runtime root, exact canonical_work_coordination selector, and one current Goal Task ID
reuse_instructions: Trigger through scripts/trigger_reusable_task.py with task_id/COSV tracking for the current canonical Goal. Parameters must bind source_root, runtime_root, only_consumer=canonical_work_coordination, and goal_task_id. The existing bridge refreshes already-local source and visits only canonical_work_coordination; Task Registry must return authentic CONTINUE before downstream mutation. WorkerCoordinator remains claim/fence authority, Interlock/InTr remains transition authority, TV/TVC remains credential authority, and Master Records remains observed-reality/reconstruction authority. Do not infer runtime success from source, CI, trigger acceptance, or device connectivity.
